mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, enterprise_id, job_id, last_message_id, last_message_time, last_message_content, student_unread_count, enterprise_unread_count, status, create_time, update_time FROM chat_session WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND (job_id = #{jobId} OR (job_id IS NULL AND #{jobId} IS NULL)) AND status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT cs.id, cs.enterprise_id, e.enterprise_name, e.logo AS enterprise_logo, cs.job_id, j.job_name, cs.last_message_content, cs.last_message_time, cs.student_unread_count AS unread_count, 0 AS is_online FROM chat_session cs LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON cs.enterprise_id = e.id LEFT JOIN job j ON cs.job_id = j.id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.status = 1
AND (e.enterprise_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR j.job_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY cs.last_message_time DESC, cs.create_time DESC

SELECT cs.id, cs.enterprise_id, e.enterprise_name, e.logo AS enterprise_logo, cs.job_id, j.job_name, 0 AS is_online FROM chat_session cs LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON cs.enterprise_id = e.id LEFT JOIN job j ON cs.job_id = j.id WHERE cs.id = #{sessionId} AND cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.status = 1 LIMIT 1
